dogecoin.text: So Dogecoin isn't so weird after all. We've always lived in a world with chain letters. But because they were clunky & awkward, chain letters typically never went viral. They were confined to the edges of the economy, petering out after a few months. We could ignore them. 4/5

Second, it solves for non-fungibility. Valuing a position in a chain letter was always tricky because each spot is different. But with Dogecoin, all spots are equal.

I wrote in more detail about these two upgrades here: https://t.co/3wI6Cm04s7 3/5

Dogecoin is actually a very old type of financial instrument: a chain letter. Dogecoin improves on previous chain letters like Circle of Gold (1978) & Mega$nets (1995) by solving two key problems.

First, Dogecoin fixes the chain letter cheating problem. No more line jumping. 2/5

People who have been around markets for a long time look at Dogecoin and shake our heads. It's weird. How could something useless, a literal joke, be worth billions? 

In this thread I'm going to try to put Dogecoin into context. 1/5
